messages:
Aisha (CS): FYI - just finished a call with MarlinHealth. Two actionable asks + a renewal nudge.
Luis (CSM): renewal nudge? numbers?
Aisha (CS): Pilot usage ~6M tokens/mo, expect ~18M with full rollout. Their main concern: per-route cost spikes when embeddings + chat run for same session.
Riley (Eng): are there repeat contexts we could cache?
Aisha (CS): yes, long patient histories. They asked for an admin toggle to disable embeddings per-route for specific workflows.
Theo (PM): so asks are: (1) per-route embeddings toggle (Console/API), (2) admin bulk-invite + role mapping for SSO. Anything else?
Aisha (CS): they also want a per-route cost preview in the Console: "what will this cost if enabled for 2k users".
Maya (Research): we can create a small estimator (tokens/session * sessions/day * model cost per token) and surface it in the UI.
Luis (CSM): renewal risk: they said without predictable cost and an easy off-switch they'd delay expansion. Not lost yet, but a negotiation lever.
Riley (Eng): note: adding a per-route boolean on the router is straightforward; UI + telemetry + billing projection need design work.
Theo (PM): priority: P0 for this account, P2 globally. Offer interim workaround + add to roadmap. Ideas?
Aisha (CS): interim: set the per-route flag manually on our side + email them a cost projection. They'd accept that for Q1 renewal.
Maya (Research): I'll build a one-off cost projection notebook and a template for similar accounts.
Riley (Eng): I'll scope API param + toggle: ~3 dev-days for API, ~2 days for telemetry.
Theo (PM): Actions: (1) Riley - scope & PR ETA by EOW; (2) Maya - send cost-template by tomorrow; (3) Luis - draft renewal note with interim workaround for MarlinHealth AM; (4) Aisha - confirm with customer.
Aisha (CS): I'll ping MarlinHealth with the interim plan and request permission to share a usage sample.
pack-bot: deploy scheduled: none. :robot_face:
Luis (CSM): also add a "cost-sensitive expansion" checkbox to the customer spreadsheet so AMs can flag accounts faster.
Theo (PM): agree. I'll add a column and attach the action items. I'll add a short spec to the backlog after Riley's scoping.
Aisha (CS): MarlinHealth is aligned with this plan for now; asked to be CC'd on the cost doc. I'll add them when Maya's notebook is ready. :thumbsup:
